messages:
maya_cs: Morning team — flagged: ~12 enterprise customers hit onboarding failures (401s) this morning when private deployments tried to exchange SSO tokens. Need a concise customer-facing status + next steps we can send in 30m. Draft below, pls review.

lisa_product: ack. can you paste the draft? i'll add ETA wording after eng confirms root cause.

maya_cs: sure — draft: ```Hi — we’re sorry for the interruption. This morning, some onboarding flows into private deployments experienced authentication failures (HTTP 401) when exchanging SSO tokens. Our engineers identified the cause and are working on a fix. Impacted steps: initial onboarding auth and credential exchange for new service connections. What we’re doing: 1) rolling a hotfix to auth middleware; 2) forcing token refresh for in-flight onboarding sessions; 3) providing dedicated support for any stuck accounts. ETA for full recovery: 2 hours. We’ll follow up with an RCA and remediation actions within 48 hours. If you want immediate help, reply and we’ll prioritize your account. — Redwood CS```

raj_eng: quick engine update: reproduction confirmed. Regression introduced in last deploy that changed token expiry handling for VPC/private control-plane handoffs. Hotfix branch created (hotfix/auth-token-restore). Rolling to canary now.

oliver_support: thanks Raj. I have five affected onboarding tickets open now. Can we add explicit steps CS can run (manual token refresh command or console flow)?

raj_eng: yes — for affected customers you can trigger a token refresh via the control plane UI: Settings > Integrations > "Re-init SSO". If they can't access UI, we can run the script: ```curl -X POST https://control.redwood.example.com/internal/refresh-token -H "Authorization: Bearer <ops-token>" -d '{"account_id":"<acct>"}'``` (ops only).

maya_cs: include that in the outbound so support and customers have an actionable next step. Also add note about credit offer for extended onboarding delays.

kate_legal: small ask — avoid promising a timeline >72h or wording that implies SLA breach admission. Suggest: keep ETA wording as "anticipated timeframe" and call out that we will follow up with an RCA and remediation plan. Also add contact path if they want dedicated bridge.

lisa_product: updated draft (short): ```Hi — we’re sorry for the interruption. This morning some customers experienced authentication failures during onboarding into private deployments. Root cause: a recent change to token expiry handling that affected SSO exchanges. Mitigation in progress: hotfix deployed to canary and being rolled to affected regions; manual token refresh guidance below; targeted support for impacted accounts. Anticipated recovery: within ~2 hours; we will share a full RCA and remediation plan within 48 hours. If you need immediate assistance, reply and we’ll open a priority bridge.```

maya_cs: that reads well. oliver, can you attach the 5 affected account IDs to the thread so engineering can prioritize?

oliver_support: adding here: acct-771, acct-884, acct-990, acct-1122, acct-1300. Also one onboarding sandbox from partner-acct-22.

raj_eng: got it. prioritizing hotfix rollout to regions where those accounts are pinned. will post progress updates here. currently canary shows successful auth exchanges for 3/3 test cases.

incident-bot: [INCIDENT-1998] Status change: investigating -> mitigating (1998765600).

maya_cs: final check: include the manual command and UI path, the offer of a credit for onboarding time lost, and a single point of contact (oliver_support). Send at :45 if engineering confirms no regressions in canary.

lisa_product: I’ll queue the message in Intercom and send the outbound at :45. tagging ops for the curl endpoint: @raj_eng please confirm when you want us to send.

raj_eng: confirmed — send at :45. hotfix will be at ~1998765900 and I’ll update if anything slips.

maya_cs: thanks all. I’ll follow up with a short tailored note to the 12 affected enterprise customers offering a 2-week onboarding credit and priority enablement session.

oliver_support: noted — created priority tickets and pinged the customers. I’ll also run the token refresh for the three customers who can’t access the UI.

kate_legal: approved the outbound wording with the edits above.

incident-bot: [INCIDENT-1998] Update: mitigating -> resolved (1998765965).
